propositions: Stale clones with mismatched store epochs must refuse to union at both sync._union_merge and push_tickets_branch non-FF retry sites rather than silently re-importing stripped history.
A new epoch field added to .store-compat.json must be compared for byte-equality between local and remote .store-compat records before any merge attempt, aborting on mismatch or reading errors.
The epoch guard must permit fast-forward adoption and behind-clone convergence by checking only within _union_merge (not before merge-base test) and only before merge invocation in push retry.
Remote .store-compat.json must be read via git show <remote_ref>:.store-compat.json to check the remote side's epoch, with distinct log messages for file-absent versus ref-unreadable failures.

Guard violations must log a warning and return/abort immediately without merging or retrying: sync._union_merge returns no-op, push_tickets_branch returns out of retry loop, preserving both pre-operation refs exactly.
The complete state matrix covering record-absent, epoch-absent, equal-epoch, mismatched-epoch, corrupt, and unreadable cases must be tested; corrupt or non-string epoch values abort as incompatible.
